meta.title: Suggst — contextual assistance for professional conversations

seo.title: Suggst — macOS meeting assistant
seo.description: Suggst case study: native macOS audio capture, local transcription, contextual prompts and OpenAI-powered answer generation.

hero.hook: Keep the meeting moving with the right context at hand.
hero.description: Suggst combines reference context, meeting-specific context and transcribed speech to prepare an answer after an explicit user action.

overview.problem: A question in a meeting may require combining reference information with discussion-specific details while the conversation continues.
overview.solution: Suggst pairs two saved contexts with authorized audio capture. On a manual trigger, it transcribes speech, extracts the request and prepares a contextual answer.
overview.audience: Meetings, video calls and professional conversations
overview.scope: Native macOS app: interface, audio, speech processing and generation

visual.title: Two complementary contexts
visual.description: Save reusable reference context and information specific to the current conversation. Long-lived reference information and discussion-specific details are stored separately.

visual.title: Native audio capture
visual.description: Select a microphone and start authorized capture, including system audio when available. The app coordinates audio sources and displays their prerequisites.

workflow.title: Finish the question
workflow.description: End the question to transcribe it.

visual.title: Explicit user trigger
visual.description: Explicitly end a question to freeze its audio clip and initiate transcription. Each action creates an identifiable process, separate from earlier questions.

visual.title: Context-aware results
visual.description: Read the extracted request and generated answer, with a clear state while processing. The answer card distinguishes waiting, available answers and failures.

architecture.description: A SwiftUI-driven pipeline processes audio locally, extracts the request and calls OpenAI with selected context.

nodes.label: Audio capture
nodes.role: Microphone, system audio and identified clips

nodes.label: Generation
nodes.role: Answer grounded in the request and contexts

challenges.title: Keep each question isolated
challenges.constraint: Asynchronous operations may finish out of order or deliver duplicate events.
challenges.solution: Per-question identities, sealed results and idempotent ingestion that rejects inconsistent events.

challenges.title: Coordinate macOS audio sources
challenges.constraint: Microphone and system audio rely on separate providers and permissions.
challenges.solution: Two coordinated native providers, with an explicit state when system capture is unavailable.

challenges.title: Handle sensitive context data
challenges.constraint: Saved contexts and conversation content may contain sensitive information.
challenges.solution: Local document storage, an API secret in Keychain and targeted context sent to OpenAI.

outcomes.title: Integrated native application
outcomes.description: Context editing, listening, preparation and answer views brought together in a SwiftUI interface.

outcomes.title: Contextual answer pipeline
outcomes.description: Audio capture, WhisperKit transcription, local extraction and OpenAI generation tied to a manual trigger.

outcomes.title: Diagnostics and validation tooling
outcomes.description: Developer cockpit, structured traces, test corpora and build scripts included in the repository.
